summary: Completed real-account auth and report API/browser verification. Admin and Guru login, secure session behavior, permissions, all XLSX exports, print HTML, role navigation, and logout passed.

integration_issues.issue: Reports component does not retain the selected report type; both Excel export and preview always call onExport/onPrint with attendance, so grades and journals cannot be exported from the browser.

action_items: Wire report-type selection to attendance/grades/journals kind for Excel export, preview, and print actions; add browser coverage for all three kinds.
critical_code_review_comments: Reports UI hardcodes attendance in App.js even though backend supports all requested report kinds.
seed_data_creation: None; used seeded Admin and Guru accounts.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL tested. Backend suite has 9 passing tests. Browser verified Admin/Guru login, role nav, attendance XLSX download, print popup, and logout. Retest report-type mapping for all three kinds after fix.
rca of the issue: Reports receives callbacks that are already bound in App render as onExport={() => downloadReport("attendance")} and onPrint={() => printReport("attendance")}; the select is uncontrolled and has no state/onChange, so its value never reaches the API.
